ai_summary: Coforge Limited disclosed the resignation of its Independent Director and NRC Chair, Mr. DK Singh, following an internal audit which revealed he and the previously resigned Board Chairman withheld critical negative performance evaluation results of the Chairman from other board members. This incident exposes significant corporate governance failings, including a deliberate lack of transparency at the highest levels and potential conflicts, raising serious questions about board integrity and oversight. The company has moved to reconstitute committees and search for new independent directors, acknowledging the need to address these issues.
